desktop.notes:
• Library albums: membership is read from each photo's .pnfo (not only the index), so a freshly pushed album no longer shows 0 photos.
• A photo put in an album on purpose is shown even if it was marked discard (discards outside albums stay hidden).
• Library changes (library.json, albums.json or any .pnfo) are picked up within ~2 s while a Library dialog is open.
• Set groups: file sets under collapsible groups (right-click → Move to group, or drag sets onto a group). Click a group to fold it; Collapse / Expand all in the menu. Existing sets stay as they were (no group).
• Collages start with no gap. New collage styles: Even (spaced out) and Scatter (overlapping towards the middle), both with a white border around each photo.
• Scatter tiles by hand: drag inside to move, near the edge to turn (Shift: 15° steps), a corner to resize. Alt+drag pans the photo inside. "Reset tiles" puts them back.
• New layout: 4 x 3 grid (12 photos). Picking a layout always starts Tiled.
